# pubber-subber

> Transport-agnostic pub/sub for Node.js. One API across in-memory, Redis, Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, AWS SNS/SQS. Bring-your-own adapter for anything else. Optional RxJS bridge. TypeScript-first, dual ESM/CJS, zero-dependency core.

## Documentation

- [Full reference](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-full.txt): everything in one file — core + every adapter + RxJS + custom adapters + examples.

## Per-package setup

- [Core](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-core.txt): `@pubber-subber/core` — `PubSub` facade, `compose()`, codecs, errors, conformance kit, custom adapter contract.
- [In-memory](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-memory.txt): `@pubber-subber/memory` — EventEmitter-backed, glob patterns, zero deps.
- [Redis](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-redis.txt): `@pubber-subber/redis` — Redis/Valkey/KeyDB/Dragonfly via `ioredis`.
- [Postgres](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-pg.txt): `@pubber-subber/pg` — Postgres `LISTEN/NOTIFY` via `pg`.
- [Google Cloud Pub/Sub](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-gcp-pubsub.txt): `@pubber-subber/gcp-pubsub` — via `@google-cloud/pubsub`.
- [AWS SNS](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-aws-sns.txt): `@pubber-subber/aws-sns` — publish-only via `@aws-sdk/client-sns`.
- [AWS SQS](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-aws-sqs.txt): `@pubber-subber/aws-sqs` — subscribe-only via `@aws-sdk/client-sqs`. Pair with `aws-sns` via `compose()` for SNS → SQS fan-out.
- [RxJS](https://github.com/samishal1998/pubber-subber/blob/main/llms-rxjs.txt): `@pubber-subber/rxjs` — optional Observable bridge.
